description: Add state machine transition validation and owner-or-admin authorization to the update_order_status endpoint to fix the security vulnerability in GitHub issue #4.
steps: Add a VALID_TRANSITIONS dict to src/models/order.py mapping each OrderStatus to the set of allowed next states: PENDING->{CONFIRMED,CANCELLED}, CONFIRMED->{SHIPPED,CANCELLED}, SHIPPED->{DELIVERED}, DELIVERED->set(), CANCELLED->set(). Add a class or module-level InvalidTransitionError exception.

Modify src/services/order_service.py: In update_order_status method, first call get_order(order_id) to fetch the current order and its current status. Then validate the requested transition using VALID_TRANSITIONS. If the transition is invalid, raise an InvalidTransitionError with a descriptive message including current and requested status. Return the current order so the handler can use it for authorization. The method signature should change to accept the current_status or the method should fetch the order internally first.

Modify src/handlers/update_order_status.py: Replace require_admin(event) with require_owner_or_admin(event, order.customer_id). The handler must first fetch the order (via service.get_order) to get the customer_id before doing the auth check. Then call service.update_order_status which will validate the transition. Import require_owner_or_admin and get_user_claims from src/utils/auth.py. Handle InvalidTransitionError with a 400 response.

Update tests/unit/test_order_service.py: Add tests for valid transitions (PENDING->CONFIRMED, PENDING->CANCELLED, CONFIRMED->SHIPPED, CONFIRMED->CANCELLED, SHIPPED->DELIVERED), invalid transitions (DELIVERED->CANCELLED, CANCELLED->PENDING, PENDING->SHIPPED, PENDING->DELIVERED, SHIPPED->CANCELLED is NOT valid per the spec), and terminal states (DELIVERED and CANCELLED cannot transition to anything).

Update tests/unit/test_handlers.py TestUpdateOrderStatusHandler: Add tests for owner updating own order status (should succeed), non-owner non-admin being rejected with 403, admin updating any order (should succeed), invalid transition returning 400, and missing auth returning 401. Update existing test_update_order_status_forbidden_non_admin to reflect the new owner-or-admin logic (non-owner non-admin should get 403).
acceptance_criteria: Valid transitions (PENDING->CONFIRMED, PENDING->CANCELLED, CONFIRMED->SHIPPED, CONFIRMED->CANCELLED, SHIPPED->DELIVERED) succeed with 200
Invalid transitions (e.g., DELIVERED->CANCELLED, CANCELLED->PENDING, PENDING->SHIPPED) are rejected with 400 status and descriptive error
Order owner can update their own order's status (200 response)
Admin can update any order's status (200 response)
All existing tests continue to pass (updated as needed for new behavior)
python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with all tests green
